title: Measured geometry and horizon dynamics of the SU(2) gauge orbit space: scale-free curvature, a localization-coherence crossover, and a coherence-governed coupling law
description: First direct Monte Carlo measurements of the Riemannian geometry of the SU(2) gauge orbit space on lattice ensembles, and of the dynamics of the approach to the Gribov horizon. Includes: scale-free curvature bounds closing Singer's curvature route with a mechanism; two Haar-disorder constants; a coupling-driven localization-coherence crossover of the lowest Faddeev-Popov mode (controlled at fixed physical volume); and a per-configuration coupling law between horizon proximity and infrared gluon power, governed by carrier coherence alone and verified by a pre-registered out-of-sample prediction. Contains the manuscript, all validated instruments and GPU notebooks (reproducible on free Kaggle GPUs), raw results, the append-only research ledger (every claim's falsifier fixed before its data; 13 refuted conjectures documented), and interactive visualizations. Research by Nitin in close collaboration with Claude (Anthropic). No claim herein bears on the existence of the Yang-Mills mass gap at infinite volume.
